food_culture: Most households eat less than they need, and the children are fed first.
commoner_resentments: Many here feel that the Free Elder Council no longer listens to people like them. Thin meals and short portions are the grievance nearly everyone shares.
outsider_impressions: A visitor soon learns that little happens here without the Free Elder Council. People here keep an eye on the wild country and mention it often. The sick are not well provided for here, and a visitor notices it.
dawn_work: Every hand that can be spared is out at first light, and what comes in is counted before it is eaten.

food_culture: There is not enough food to go round, and everyone knows it.
commoner_resentments: There is little trust here that the Elder Council will do right by ordinary people. People resent paying more for less, and they say so at the stalls.
outsider_impressions: Nothing of weight is agreed here without the leave of the Religious Authorities. Living this near the wild has made people watchful, and a visitor notices it. A visitor who needs a ruling or a permission should expect to wait for it.
dawn_work: Hunters are out before light, and the rest of the day waits on what they bring home.

food_culture: Rations are tight, and the poor eat watered stew.
commoner_resentments: People put up with the Elder Council, but they expect little of it. Going short at table is the complaint heard most often here.
outsider_impressions: Whatever a visitor wants done, the Religious Authorities have a say in it. This is frontier country, and people speak of the wild beyond as close at hand. Nobody here is paid to keep the peace, and it shows.
dawn_work: Dawn work is the search for food: people are out before light to see what can be found.

food_culture: Food is short, and many households go to bed hungry.
commoner_resentments: Many here feel that the Feudal Stewardship no longer listens to people like them. Households that go short look hard at the ones that do not.
outsider_impressions: The Religious Authorities carry the most weight here, and nobody pretends otherwise. The wild is not far off, and visitors hear stories of what comes out of it. Its defences are thin, and a visitor sees how little stands ready.
dawn_work: Dawn work is the search for food: people are out before light to see what can be found.
